tasks.prompt: Rename the slugify function to toSlug everywhere it is defined or used. Do not change behavior. Run the tests.

Add a schedule feature across three source files. (1) In src/duration.ts add formatDuration(ms: number): string that renders a non-negative integer number of milliseconds as whole units, largest first, separated by single spaces, omitting units that are zero, using d (86400000 ms), h (3600000), m (60000), s (1000), and ms; 0 renders as '0ms'; 5400000 renders as '1h 30m' and 1500 as '1s 500ms'; throw on a negative or non-integer input. (2) In src/strings.ts add titleCase(input: string): string that trims the input, splits it on runs of whitespace, uppercases the first character of each word and lowercases the rest, and joins the words with single spaces ('hello   WORLD' becomes 'Hello World'; an empty string stays empty). (3) Create src/schedule.ts exporting describeSchedule(name: string, every: string) that returns { slug, everyMs, label } where slug is slugify(name), everyMs is parseDuration(every), and label is titleCase(name) + ' every ' + formatDuration(everyMs); describeSchedule('Nightly Build', '90m') returns { slug: 'nightly-build', everyMs: 5400000, label: 'Nightly Build every 1h 30m' }. Add tests for each part in tests/duration.test.ts, tests/strings.test.ts, and a new tests/schedule.test.ts. When .doug/plan.json exists it carries the approved plan for this change: three tasks in two levels. Run the tests and the typecheck to confirm.
